"""Prepare this candidate's explicit A/I profile and run the no-generation probe."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import secrets
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
c = payload['config']
root = Path(c['root'])
private = root/'private'
config_dir = root/'analysis/config'
state_dir = root/'analysis/state'
out = {'candidate_id': c['candidate_id'], 'batch_id': c['batch_id'], 'status': 'preparing',
       'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'generation_calls': 0}


def save_secret(path, value, *, uid=None):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        path.chmod(0o600)
        stream.write(value)
    if uid:
        os.chown(path, *uid)


def run(args, body=None):
    result = subprocess.run(args, input=body, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
                            timeout=c['command_timeout_seconds'])
    if result.returncode:
        p = private/('analysis-prepare-error-'+secrets.token_hex(4)+'.txt')
        save_secret(p, result.stderr+'\n'+result.stdout)
        raise RuntimeError('command_exit_'+str(result.returncode)+'; private_detail='+str(p))
    return result.stdout


try:
    names = run(['docker', 'ps', '-a', '--format', '{{.Names}}']).splitlines()
    assert c['container'] not in names
    assert not config_dir.exists() and not state_dir.exists()
    config_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    state_dir.mkdir()
    uid = tuple(int(x) for x in c['user'].split(':'))
    os.chown(state_dir, *uid)
    for name, content in payload['files'].items():
        assert Path(name).name == name
        (config_dir/name).write_text(content)
    (config_dir/'deployment.json').write_text(json.dumps(c, indent=2)+'\n')
    source_env = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in Path(c['private_model_source']).read_text().splitlines()
                      if line and not line.startswith('#') and '=' in line)
    http = json.loads(Path(c['private_http_source']).read_text())
    db_url = http['SOCAI2_CASE_DATABASE_URL']
    assert urlsplit(db_url).path == '/'+c['database'] and urlsplit(db_url).username == c['writer']
    if db_url.startswith('postgresql+asyncpg:'):
        db_url = db_url.replace('postgresql+asyncpg:', 'postgresql+psycopg:', 1)
    assert db_url.startswith('postgresql+psycopg:')
    redis_secret = json.loads(Path(c['private_redis_source']).read_text())['password']
    redis_url = 'redis://:'+quote(redis_secret, safe='')+'@'+c['redis_container']+':'+str(c['redis_port'])+'/'+str(c['redis_db'])
    save_secret(private/'analysis-database-url', db_url+'\n', uid=uid)
    save_secret(private/'analysis-redis-url', redis_url+'\n', uid=uid)
    env = dict(c['runtime_env'])
    for key in ('SECRET_KEY', 'JWT_SECRET', 'METRICS_TOKEN', 'AISOC_CREDENTIAL_KEY', 'AISOC_REALTIME_JWT_SECRET'):
        assert source_env.get(key)
        env[key] = source_env[key]
    env.update(OPENAI_API_KEY=source_env[c['model_key_name']], OPENAI_MODEL=c['model_alias'],
        OPENAI_BASE_URL=c['model_base_url'], DATABASE_URL=db_url, SOCAI2_CASE_DATABASE_URL=db_url,
        REDIS_URL=redis_url, SOCAI2_KNOWLEDGE_PROFILE='')
    assert all('\n' not in value and '\r' not in value for value in env.values())
    save_secret(Path(c['private_runtime_path']), ''.join(key+'='+value+'\n' for key,value in sorted(env.items())))
    base = ['docker', 'run', '--network', c['network'], '--workdir', c['workdir'], '--user', c['user'],
        '--memory', c['memory'], '--pids-limit', str(c['pids_limit']), '--env-file', c['private_runtime_path'],
        '--mount', 'type=bind,src='+str(config_dir)+',dst=/run/analysis,readonly',
        '--mount', 'type=bind,src='+str(state_dir)+',dst=/var/lib/analysis',
        '--mount', 'type=bind,src='+str(private/'analysis-database-url')+',dst=/run/secrets/analysis-database-url,readonly',
        '--mount', 'type=bind,src='+str(private/'analysis-redis-url')+',dst=/run/secrets/analysis-redis-url,readonly']
    (root/'analysis/docker-base.json').write_text(json.dumps(base, indent=2)+'\n')
    probe = run([*base, '--rm', '-i', '--entrypoint', 'python', c['image'], '-'], payload['probe'])
    out['readiness'] = json.loads(probe.splitlines()[-1])
    out['config_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    out['status'] = 'passed'
except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- preserve this one-shot preparation failure
    out['status'] = 'failed'
    out['error'] = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, RuntimeError) else type(exc).__name__
finally:
    out['ended_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
sys.exit(1 if out['status'] == 'failed' else 0)

"""Candidate A/I readiness only: real resolver/tokenizer, never generation or dispatch."""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID

import httpx
from app.socai2.analysis_case_executor import executors
from app.socai2.analysis_dispatch_runtime import load_profile, validate_executors
from app.socai2.analysis_task_policy import AnalysisTaskPolicy
from app.socai2.analysis_tasks import AnalysisTaskService
from app.socai2.baseline_analysis_model import TenantChatGateway
from app.socai2.runtime_policy import active_policy
from app.socai2.stage_results import StageResultService
from redis.asyncio import Redis
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine


async def main():
    config = json.loads(Path('/run/analysis/deployment.json').read_text())
    profile = load_profile('/run/analysis/dispatcher.json')
    policy = active_policy()
    engine = create_async_engine(Path(profile['database_url_file']).read_text().strip(),
        hide_parameters=True, connect_args=profile['database_connect_args'])
    sessions = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)
    lifecycle = AnalysisTaskPolicy(**json.loads(Path(profile['lifecycle_policy_file']).read_text()))
    task_service = AnalysisTaskService(sessions, lifecycle)
    stage_service = StageResultService(sessions)
    redis = Redis.from_url(Path(profile['redis_url_file']).read_text().strip(),
        socket_timeout=profile['redis_socket_timeout_seconds'],
        socket_connect_timeout=profile['redis_connect_timeout_seconds'])
    out = {'generation_calls': 0, 'dispatcher_started': False}
    try:
        loaded = executors(json.loads(Path(profile['executor_config_file']).read_text()), task_service)
        validate_executors(loaded)
        out['executors'] = sorted(loaded)
        async with stage_service.transaction(UUID(profile['tenant_id']), readonly=True) as store:
            row = (await store.db.execute(text('SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS role, ssl, version FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()'))).mappings().one()
            out['postgres'] = dict(row)
            assert row['database'] == config['database'] and row['role'] == config['writer'] and row['ssl']
            for table in config['source_tables']:
                await store.db.execute(text('SELECT * FROM '+table+' LIMIT 0'))
            out['readable_sources'] = config['source_tables']
            out['guard_counts'] = {name: (await store.db.execute(text('SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.'+name))).scalar_one()
                for name in ('runs', 'analysis_attempts', 'cases')}
            assert not any(out['guard_counts'].values())
        out['redis'] = {'ping': await redis.ping(), 'keys': await redis.dbsize(), 'database': config['redis_db']}
        assert out['redis']['keys'] == 0
        gateway = TenantChatGateway()
        assert await gateway.configure(stage_service, UUID(profile['tenant_id']))
        assert gateway.model == config['model_alias'] and gateway.config.base_url == config['model_base_url']
        assert gateway.provider == policy.model.protocol and gateway.schema_profile == policy.model.schema_profile
        out['model'] = {'allowed': True, 'source': gateway.config.source, 'alias': gateway.model,
            'base_url': gateway.config.base_url, 'protocol': gateway.provider, 'schema_profile': gateway.schema_profile}
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=config['probe_timeout_seconds'], trust_env=False) as client:
            response = await client.get(config['model_base_url']+'/models', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer '+gateway.config.api_key})
            response.raise_for_status()
            aliases = [item['id'] for item in response.json()['data']]
            assert gateway.model in aliases
            out['model']['alias_listed'] = True
            response = await client.get(config['backend_base_url']+'/models')
            response.raise_for_status()
            models = [item['id'] for item in response.json()['data']]
            assert config['backend_model'] in models
            out['model']['backend_models'] = models
        body = {'model': gateway.model, 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Token counting readiness only.'}],
            'max_tokens': policy.model.output_tokens['A'], 'temperature': 0}
        out['token_measurement'] = await gateway.measure(body, 'A')
        assert out['token_measurement']['context_fits']
        out['policy_sha256'] = policy.sha256
        out['runtime_files'] = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in Path('/run/analysis').iterdir() if p.is_file()}
        out['status'] = 'passed'
        print(json.dumps(out))
    finally:
        await redis.aclose()
        await engine.dispose()


asyncio.run(main())
